w2:textbox.label: Check if the Current Page Is a WFrame Popup

1. Click the button at the bottom.  
2. Verify that a WFrame popup is created.  
3. Verify that the source (src) screen of the WFrame popup contains the WFrame.  
4. Click the first button inside the WFrame of the popup.
5. Verify that false is returned because the current screen is a WFrame.  
6. Click the second button inside the WFrame of the popup.  
7. Verify that true is returned because its parent is the WFrame popup.  
(See the wframe_src.xml file for detailed scripting.)
